risk_note: RV2 settlement (settlement-plan B2-04m, S2; BR-FUND-01 R5, BR-FUND-04 ⑦⑩⑫, BR-FUND-05, BR-FUND-16, BR-CALC-13; D10-272). Single-order credit in one PG transaction: order_key advisory lock, users rows ascending through identity lockUsersForUpdate, balance rows ascending, then a BeneficiaryGate (identity deletion / realname readers, risk state batch reader; no direct users SELECT) rereads beneficiary states after the locks; WAITING / hold / rights_pending / settle seq are revalidated; the B2-04e plan is posted through ledger with BR-FUND-05 voucher kinds and uniq_keys (replay credits once); held beneficiaries get first_credit obligations without touching the order hold; one CAS writes CREDITED via the generated order-rebate transition, the booked pair and credited_at (money round 1); order.credited is published in the same transaction. Orders with tlj_deduct_fen > 0 are skipped with a warning and nothing written (D10-272). Wiring into app.module is B2-04zb.
